findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/Finite.lean:62` has `theorem coe_edgeFinset : (G.edgeFinset : Set (Sym2 V)) = G.edgeSet`, and `Mathlib/Data/Set/Card.lean:98` has `encard_coe_eq_coe_finsetCard`. The PR's simpa lists the definition name `edgeFinset` as a simp lemma.
findings.fix: Prove a single per-cut equivalence once and use it in both directions. Rewrite with Mathlib's `coe_edgeFinset` (`← coe_edgeFinset`) and `Set.encard_coe_eq_coe_finsetCard` instead of unfolding `edgeFinset`. If the decidability instances still differ, use `convert` and add a comment saying why.
findings.issue: Both directions of `isCutMinimal_iff` use the same `simpa only [..., edgeFinset, Set.toFinset_card, Set.fintypeCard_eq_ncard, ...]`, which unfolds the `edgeFinset` definition and depends on how the `Fintype` instance for `edgeSet` is chosen. The second direction adds an undocumented `classical` to get around an instance mismatch.

findings.evidence: The proof uses only `G.Adj u v → u ≠ v` (`h.ne`), which holds for any pair of vertex sets. A grep of `Mathlib/Combinatorics/SimpleGraph` found no existing `between` lemma for this (only `between_adj`, `between_le`, `between_comm`).
findings.fix: Factor it out as a named lemma, e.g. `between_eq_inf_top_between (s t : Set V) : G.between s t = G ⊓ (⊤ : SimpleGraph V).between s t`, and rewrite with it plus `edgeFinset_inf`.
findings.issue: The local `hbetween : G.between S Sᶜ = G ⊓ ⊤.between S Sᶜ` (together with `hfin`) is a general fact that holds for any `s t`, not a one-off, but it is buried inside a single proof.

summary: Most proofs are robust (simp/tauto, then a reused cardinality lemma plus omega), but `isCutMinimal_iff` closes both directions with the same `simpa` that unfolds the `edgeFinset` definition and depends on which instance is chosen. A general reusable fact is also buried as a local `have`.
